nameChange.text: Since my father is Komanin Andrey Nikolaevich, in the future my name will be Komanin Nikolai Andreevich. To resolve this matter, in the summer of 2026, Andrey filed an application with the court located in our district so that I could officially change my surname and patronymic. mirea.title: Mirea Study
mirea.stackDesc: Currently, I am concurrently mastering the fundamental basis: development in C++, C#, and the scripting language Python. In the second year, deepening into web engineering through Java and SQL databases will begin. Furthermore, as an AI specialist, I am actively learning to professionally interact with models and engineer effective prompts for neural networks.
